topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: Hey, I can't believe this happened. I got this package today, and as soon as I saw the name, I knew it wasn't mine. It’s for the person who used to live here. I opened it, just a tiny bit, thinking maybe it was something important, you know? But it’s just some old books and DVDs. I feel so weird about it. I should have just left it alone, but now I’m stuck with it. I’m going to drop it off at the post office tomorrow, try to send it back. Can you believe I didn’t even think to check the address properly before I signed for it? Sigh, I hope they find their way back to the right person.
